name: Jom-jom's Escape
summary: Jom-jom wants to return home and asks you to escort him to Clugfist at Bolder'ok.

sections.title: The Way Home
sections.body: At Bolder'ok, Jom-jom needs you to guide him to Clugfist. He came looking for a friend, and now he wants to go home.

faq.answer: Jom-jom came looking for a friend and now wants to go home.

faq.q: Where does Jom-jom want to go?
faq.answer: Jom-jom wants to return home, and you are asked to escort him to Clugfist at Bolder'ok.
Clugfist is the one Jom-jom is to be escorted to at Bolder'ok.
Jom-jom came looking for a friend.

faq.q: Does Jom-jom consider you a friend?
faq.answer: After you save him, Jom-jom calls you a friend.
